solution:
Line 1 defines x and y. The given equality then gives d=cx2 (3). Substituting c=ay gives d=(ay)x2 (5), then d=ax2y (9).

Regroup this as d=(ax)xy (7), and substitute ax=b to obtain d=bxy (4). Thus logbd=xy=(logab)(logac).

The required order is 1, 3, 5, 9, 7, 4: answer C.
